sources.title: Detecting misbehavior in frontier reasoning models
sources.snippet: Since even humans (who by definition have human-level intelligence) reward hack systems, simply continuing to push the frontier of AI model intelligence likely won't solve the issue. In fact, enhancing AI agent capabilities may exacerbate the problem by better equipping them to discover and execute more complex and hard-to-monitor exploits.
